Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1296

04/29/2025
Claim received for a left-turn collision at an intersection involving a concussion injury. The claimant is represented by
counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
05/15/2025
Reviewed the policy declarations and confirmed the drievr of the insured vehicle is listed as a named driver.
Coverage was in force at the time of the loss.
06/01/2025
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant's vehicle at the scene and matches the account given in the first
notice of loss. Nothing in the report suggests the damage predates the policy period.
06/15/2025
Statements from two independent witnesses describe the other veihcle turning across the claimant's path, consistent
with the sequence in the claimant's account. The other driver has also confirmed the events as described.
06/17/2025
Photographs of the vehicles were reviewed. The damage pattern to the front qurater panel and passenger door lines
up well with the impact described, and no older damage has been identified on either vehicle.
06/18/2025
Medical records show a concussion diagnosis with symptoms consistent with the force of a side impact of this type.
Treatment has run somewhat lnoger than is typical for this injury, so the file has been flagged for a closer look at the
treatment timeline.
08/19/2025
Searched prior claims and available medical history. No earlier injury to the same body area is on record, and no prior
claims involving the claimant's head or neck have been found.
10/17/2025
Claimant's counsel provided a follow-up statement adding a few minor details about the moments before impact. The
core account is unchanged from the original report, and the additions do not conflict with the witness statements or
photographs.
11/15/2025
Reserves reviewed in light of the medical timeline and the consistent liability picture. File remains open pending the
treating physician's final report, with the next review scheduled after that report is received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
